disposition_reason: Tables 2-4 print iron, lead, cobalt, manganese, cadmium, copper and nickel (ppm) in market vegetables, fruits and fruit peels from Quetta.

study.design: market survey of five vegetables, six fruit samples, fruit peels and apple endocarp
study.origin: per Table 1: Khuzdar, Quetta, Kuchlak, Noshki (Balochistan), Sindh, Punjab, Swat, Karachi, Afghanistan, Turkey
study.market: local market of Quetta city, Pakistan
study.method: rinsed, oven dried 50 °C, HNO3/HClO4/H2SO4 (5:1:1) wet digestion, flame AAS
study.qa: samples run three times with three or four standards per metal; no CRM or recovery reported
